name: copilot-auto
description: GitHub Copilot auto-session routing for oh-my-pi (OMP) and Pi: injects github-copilot/auto, uses session/intent routing, and stamps Copilot-Session-Token through native request-local transports.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external '@oh-my-pi/pi-ai' --external '@earendil-works/pi-ai' && bun build src/omp-entry.ts --outfile dist/omp.js --target bun --external '@oh-my-pi/pi-ai' && bun build src/pi-entry.ts --outfile dist/pi.js --target bun --external '@earendil-works/pi-ai'
